doc: Chapter 4, LCROSS (October 2009) (issue #48; story: docs/design/story-v0.3.0.md). Every fact from NASA pages (S-lcross-nasa, S-lcross-nssdc). The crew fly it from mission control: the craft is meant to crash, so nobody rides it. The story's lines: Killa 'The plan is to crash?', Wayra 'Yes.', Killa 'OK.'. Same format as pathfinder.json.
mission: Between intro and outro the player plays the mission: the aim at Cabeus, then the four minutes (scripts/screens/lcross.gd).

intro.text: Twelve years after Mars, a rocket's empty upper stage flew to the Moon with a small craft riding on it.
intro.fact: LCROSS launched on June 18, 2009, with the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter, on an Atlas V.

intro.text: Here is the plan. The empty Centaur hits a dark crater at the south pole. Our craft follows four minutes behind and looks at what it throws up.
intro.fact: The Centaur hit Cabeus at 11:31 UT; the shepherding craft flew through the plume and hit four minutes later.

intro.text: Two thousand kilograms of empty rocket at two and a half kilometers a second. That is a big splash.
intro.fact: The 2000 kg Centaur upper stage hit at about 2.5 km/s.

intro.text: And I keep our craft looking into the splash. From down here. For once nobody rides it.
Separation now. Aim the Centaur at the dark floor of Cabeus.
intro.fact: The shepherding craft separated from the Centaur at 01:50 UT on October 9, 2009, and let it go ahead.

outro.text: 11:31 UT. A flash at the bottom of Cabeus, then a cloud rising into the sunlight. Four minutes later, a second flash.
outro.fact: The Centaur hit Cabeus at 11:31 UT; the shepherding craft flew through the plume and hit four minutes later.

outro.text: Water! In the light from the splash. I knew it!
outro.fact: On November 13, 2009, NASA announced that the data showed the mission had found water near the Moon's south pole.

outro.text: We crashed twice. On purpose. And it worked.
Next one is bigger. They want to push an asteroid.
